items: A sidebar with your projects: pick the project at the top and everything in it is close at hand, on a desktop, a tablet or a phone.
Each project opens on an overview of where its work stands: interviews, records, species, and what is still waiting to be reviewed.
Guided tours: each section explains itself step by step the first time you open it. Skip them, and see them again with the ? button on each page or from My account.

An example project, with invented data, to walk through every section and experiment without worrying about breaking anything before starting your own. It is yours alone and you can remove it whenever you like.
Field records have a section of their own, next to collecting permits. Besides collected specimens, you can record what was only observed, and keep its determinations and accession numbers.
Records, photographs and voice notes taken with the field app reach the web, and each record shows which interview answer it came out of.
In My account you can see where you are signed in, and sign out of any browser or field device.
Long recordings sent from the field app no longer start over when the connection drops: they carry on where they left off.
Design interview forms and capture interviews on the web or with the field app, even offline.
Link answers to the project's species catalog.
Compute the ethnobotanical indices (RFC, UV, CI, ICF and FL) and export the data.
